plan.title: Send RFQ Counter Offer During Evaluation

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Ensure RFQ counter offers are enabled for the tenant.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled for the tenant.
Open the RFQ stage's Responses tab where Vendor A's bid and Counter Offer control are shown.
Send the buyer's counter offer on Vendor A's normal bid with the requested price and remark.
Assert that Vendor A's bid is marked as having a counter offer initiated.
Assert that the sent counter offer replaced the Counter Offer action with the revoke link.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier portal to check that the offer is delivered to the vendor.
Open the event overview in Vendor A's portal.
Assert that Vendor A can see the pending counter offer and its acceptance action.
